title: Six Hands on the Same Winter
player_facing_question: Who were the six people later flattened into Keeper icons, what did each know through their work, and where did each choose safety, comfort, or silence?
plausible_initial_belief: The Keeper stones describe one coherent council, or six ceremonial roles whose records can be decoded by repeating one method.
human_stake: Vaun, Mara, Sella, Orin, Brann, and Iss protected real people and also made distinct compromises. Their evidence must remain six voices because their disagreements are how the later truth survives.
earned_belief: The Keepers were six distinct contemporaries with incompatible jobs, handwriting, relationships, evidence, and culpabilities. None is a complete villain or absolved custodian.
required_inference: Each lane requires a different professional judgment. The group must then assign knowledge, action, omission, and later correction to six separate people; collecting names or extracting six letters is not completion.
callback: P5's ordinary service records become expert evidence: the same ration exception, manual leaf, sample jar, low seam, rota, and living reed reveal who noticed what and when.

consequence.minecraft: Each archive workroom receives a distinct open dossier drawer and one sealed affidavit housing; the six housings remain separate.
consequence.npc: Surviving remembered conversations stop using honorific titles and name the six as people.
consequence.discord: The shared docket renders a responsibility matrix, not six solve badges.

dossiers.operation: Reconcile received goods, issue receipts, seal repairs, and private household exceptions across independent hands.

evidence.provenance: Vaun's numbered receiving hand; countersigned at gate
evidence.content: Twelve filter bolts received. Seven sent to cistern. Five assigned by heat order without destination receipts. Sixteen charcoal sacks received. Ten sent to cistern. Six assigned likewise.

evidence.provenance: returned bolts carry market stitch; diverted bolts listed under private heat use
evidence.content: The missing cloth was not lost in transit: two returned fragments carry the favored-gallery repair stitch and Vaun's own reseal wax.

evidence.provenance: later scan; redaction layer recoverable from cached thumbnail
evidence.content: I balanced the page because an unbalanced page would have stopped issue for everyone. I told myself I could challenge the order after winter. Winter became the name for not challenging it.

dossiers.finding: Vaun precisely tracked a deliberate diversion and protected continuity of issue, but his private accuracy became a way to postpone public resistance.

dossiers.operation: Establish edition provenance from paper stock, signatures, binding sequence, corrections, and route consequences.

evidence.provenance: E1 school stock, E2 stores stock, E3 emergency rag paper; all visibly occupied
evidence.content: E1 routes families around third bay. E2 silently moves the public arrow through it. E3 restores the old route in Mara's margin but keeps the unsafe clean plate.

evidence.provenance: discarded binding basket; Mara and junior copier Lio
evidence.content: Lio: If the clean plate is wrong, why copy it clean? Mara: Because a correction no one receives is a private virtue. Lio: That is not an answer. Mara: No. It is the part I am still able to write.

evidence.provenance: dispatch counts align only with E2 issue dates
evidence.content: The substituted edition was not theoretical: three family dispatches and one brace crew were routed through the stressed bay before E3 margins circulated.

dossiers.finding: Mara can prove which manual was substituted and how it changed movement; she preserved the correction but also produced the authoritative clean copy that hid it.

dossiers.operation: Reconstruct a damp transfer from fixed landmarks, front/back paper fibers, sample sketches, and measured bearings.

evidence.provenance: pupil copies dated before intake dispute
evidence.content: Sella's pupils draw the bent alder, split sill, and three-reed shelf. One writes: The water does not care which way the council faces the paper.

evidence.provenance: fiber tears and pinholes match the Minecraft original; reverse image is physically caused, not an arbitrary mirror cipher
evidence.content: When aligned by alder, sill, and shelf, the transferred line reaches the lower intake rather than the official upper mark.

evidence.provenance: lower jar position scraped from official index; Sella's sketch retains it
evidence.content: Lower draw: dark grit before cloth fibers. Keep sealed. If this line disappears from the fair copy, ask stores where the good cloth went.

dossiers.finding: Sella's transferable survey proves the true intake and an omitted lower sample; her playful teaching method became durable forensic provenance.

dossiers.operation: Compare mineral age, seam width, brace dimensions, load promises, and a conditional certificate.

evidence.provenance: marks cut before Iss's last excavation; mineral fill crosses older tool scars
evidence.content: Third bay seam exceeds the service limit at two braces. The mineralized edge proves movement began well before the fresh route cut.

evidence.provenance: ordered section 6x8; delivered cores 4x6; stores receipt countersigned
evidence.content: The installed brace is not the brace Orin calculated. The promised load reduction never appears in pressure allocation.

evidence.provenance: Orin signature genuine; condition later scraped from public copy
evidence.content: Service may continue only if upper heat load is halved and the east brace is replaced before thaw. In the margin: They asked whether I would rather close the school galleries tonight. I signed the condition. They kept only the signature.

dossiers.finding: Orin documented chronic damage and made operation conditional, then accepted a promise he could not enforce; later copies retained his authority and removed his warning.

dossiers.operation: Reconcile substitutions, meal chits, paired lamp states, toll notation, and fixed clip 3 without relying on sound.

evidence.provenance: Brann correction ink; two hands acknowledge relief
evidence.content: Iven's eighth-hour cell is empty because Pell relieved him. The official clean rota places Iven there anyway.

evidence.provenance: market batch time and two-lamp shapes independently place Pell at watch
evidence.content: Pell collected two meals at relief and lit the paired board. The ninth toll written later as eight contradicts both ordinary records.

evidence.provenance: hash-bound asset clip_03_watch_correction; reveal after local watch question is established
evidence.content: STAY AWAKE is the packet label. Its useful content is the paired visual coverage and corrected relief order, not a supernatural command to avoid sleep.

dossiers.finding: Brann protected exhausted watchers through paired coverage and left redundant proof that the official timestamp was rewritten.

dossiers.operation: Test a persuasive route case against biological provenance, allocation records, authorization gaps, and corrected margins.

evidence.provenance: living-green tissue at collection; date independently logged by Sella
evidence.content: The surface was genuinely recovering. This finding is true and important even though it does not justify Iss's route.

evidence.provenance: three witnesses preserve overlapping but non-identical recollections
evidence.content: Iss argued that permanent confinement was becoming a policy, not a weather fact. He named children who had never seen open sky. He omitted the stressed bay, diverted heat, and unpaired cut crew.

evidence.provenance: cached first upload lacks three warnings present in local draft; account edit chronology is mundane and verifiable
evidence.content: The draft names brace load, paired watch, and Averyn's objection. The public copy removes all three and calls the route a mercy.

dossiers.finding: Iss was right that the surface healed and right to challenge permanent confinement; he made the case persuasive by hiding risks, diverted resources, and supported exclusion of Averyn's objection.

group_conclusion.prompt: File a responsibility matrix for six people: profession, what each could prove, the compromise each made, and the later correction each preserved.
accepted_answers: Vaun, Mara, Sella, Orin, Brann, and Iss were six distinct contemporaries whose different work preserved independent evidence; each protected people, made a different compromise, and later left a separate affidavit rather than forming one Keeper mind.

meaningful_wrong_theories.theory: The six titles describe one rotating office.
meaningful_wrong_theories.response: The archive records the theory, then returns simultaneous cross-signatures, incompatible work locations, direct disagreements, and six independent hands.

meaningful_wrong_theories.theory: Iss alone corrupted an otherwise honest council.
meaningful_wrong_theories.response: Iss's omissions are established, but Vaun's diversion silence, Mara's clean edition, Orin's conditional signature, and the altered watch record predate or exceed his route.

meaningful_wrong_theories.theory: All six secretly coordinated the later affidavits as a successful release plan.
meaningful_wrong_theories.response: The six independent affidavits preserve a route to a name, but no evidence shows they completed a release; the distinction is retained for later investigation.

hints.H0: Choose a workroom, not a stone. Each dossier asks a question that profession could answer.
hints.H1: If two lanes feel identical, return to the material: inventory balances, edition history, transfer geometry, structural tolerances, watch chronology, and route advocacy require different judgments.
hints.H2: For the group matrix, separate what each knew from what each did, omitted, and corrected later.
hints.H3: File six rows: Vaun/diversion, Mara/substituted edition, Sella/true intake, Orin/signed-away warning, Brann/rewritten watch, Iss/healed surface plus concealed route risk.

novelty_comparison: P5 compares social versions across one institution. P6 changes operation and spatial rhythm six times because each person's work produces different proof, then reconverges on responsibility rather than a cipher ladder.
